explication: Ciphey is a Rust library and CLI for automatically decoding text. The CLI parses input and configuration, then calls the library’s cracking entry point; the search explores candidate decoding paths, runs filtered decoders, and checks results for plaintext until success or timeout. Major capabilities include multiple cipher/encoding decoders, configurable plaintext detection, A* search with caching and prioritisation, multi-level decoding, top-results collection, and database-backed cache/statistics. The excerpts establish CLI, search, timer, and result-storage wiring; some internal library and database call paths are documented but not shown.
